title: Grade 3 French — Fri, May 22
description: Weather & Simple Sentences (Le Temps et les Phrases Simples) — Last Week Day 5
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'It is sunny' in French?
options: Il fait beau / Il y a du soleil
questions.explanation: 'Il fait beau' or 'Il y a du soleil' = It is sunny.

questions.question: How do you say 'It is raining' in French?
How do you say 'It is snowing' in French?
What does 'Il y a du vent' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il y a du vent' = It is windy (literally 'there is some wind').

questions.question: In French, simple sentences follow the order:
questions.explanation: French sentences usually follow Subject + Verb + Object (SVO), like English: 'Je mange une pomme' (I eat an apple).

questions.question: What does 'Je joue' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je joue' = I play. From the verb 'jouer' (to play).

questions.question: What does 'Il mange une pizza' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il mange une pizza' = He eats a pizza. 'Il' = he, 'mange' = eats, 'une pizza' = a pizza.

questions.question: How do you make a sentence negative in French?
questions.explanation: Negation: ne + verb + pas. 'Je mange' → 'Je ne mange pas' (I don't eat).

questions.question: What does 'Elle chante' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Elle chante' = She sings. 'Elle' = she, 'chanter' = to sing.

questions.question: How do you say 'We play football' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Nous jouons au football' = We play football. 'Nous' = we.

questions.question: What does 'Quel temps fait-il?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Quel temps fait-il?' = What is the weather like?

questions.question: Describe rainy weather: complete the sentence 'Aujourd'hui, ___.'
questions.explanation: 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut' = Today, it is raining.

questions.question: What does 'J'aime le printemps' mean?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime le printemps' = I like spring. 'Le printemps' = spring.
